core.title: Declare a testing witness for every implementation component
core.given: An implementation component identified by the traceability closure check
core.when: The component is created or changed, or the closure check runs
core.then: The component declares a testing witness.
prefer: Declare the testing witness in the same change that introduces the component, naming the test that exercises it
avoid: Leaving an identified implementation component with no declared testing witness
Declaring a placeholder or unrelated witness just to satisfy the presence check
core.why: Traceability closure requires every implementation component to point to the test that witnesses it; a witness can only be resolved and checked once it is declared.
evidence: The traceability closure check reports no identified implementation component without a declared testing witness
verification: Enforced by a repository-wide traceability closure check: it identifies implementation components from the implementation files in scope and fails each one lacking a declared testing witness; the concrete component-identification and witness-declaration syntax belong to the stack's realization of that check.
Disposition strict: every finding fails; no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.

The check does not cover whether a declared witness actually resolves to an existing test (that is the companion rule on witness resolution), nor files it does not identify as implementation components.

The exact file scope of the check (including any vendored or generated trees excluded from scanning) is owned by the stack's realization of the check; the core only requires the check to run over the implementation files in scope.

fires: A new implementation component is added and the traceability closure check identifies it as a component
An existing identified implementation component has no declared testing witness when the closure check runs
doesNotFire: Files the traceability closure check does not identify as implementation components (e.g. test files themselves)
Checking whether a declared witness actually resolves to an existing test (that is the companion rule on witness resolution)

profileRequirements.meaning: What the core needs: the stack's concrete traceability-header syntax by which an implementation component declares its testing witness (the test that exercises it). This is the urn.header map's home for the Tested-By-style declaration field.
profileRequirements.bunValue: not spelled out in bun.json: the validator only requires that a component 'declares a testing witness' 'naming the test that exercises it'; bun.json supplies no concrete declaration syntax, and that absence stays explicit rather than being filled by inference

neutralityNotes: The obligation itself is fully neutral and kept verbatim. What could not be neutralized: (1) the validator id atdd_traceability_closure and its validator-prefixed finding id atdd_traceability_closure:tested-by-missing are realization details, kept bunOnly, with core:verification naming the check generically as 'the traceability closure check'; (2) how implementation components are identified, how a witness is declared, and the check's exact file scope (including excluded trees) are all owned by the stack's realization of that check in Bun, so the core defers them and claims no profile key for them — roles.assignment is deliberately not required because bun.json supplies no file-to-role assignment data, only the per-rule validator reference; the only profile need is the witness-declaration syntax, referenced as the entry urn.header#testing_witness of the existing traceability-header map (which covers the Tested-By field); bun.json does not supply any concrete declaration syntax, and that absence remains explicit rather than being filled by inference; (3) doesNotFire's reference to the sibling rule traceability.source.tested-by-resolves was genericized to 'the companion rule on witness resolution' because the sibling's current id was not among the inputs; (4) the shared strict-disposition policy (no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline) is folded into core:verification.
